output.summary: A flowering perennial native to much of Europe and parts of Asia, sweet woodruff has foliage whose sweet scent strengthens as it wilts and persists when dried. It was, and to some extent remains, used to flavour drinks, preserves, ice cream, tea and other foods.
output.edibilityNote: Historically and partly still used to flavour alcoholic and soft drinks, jelly, jam, ice cream, herbal tea and other sweets.
